objections.We have strict privacy requirements: Absolutely — Health Cloud is built for healthcare compliance. It meets Privacy Act requirements, can be configured for ACHS standards, and keeps all data onshore. We work with providers under similar constraints every day.
objections.Our staff aren't tech-savvy: That's actually why AI works so well here — it handles the tech complexity behind the scenes. Staff just talk to it naturally. One aged care CEO told us her 60-year-old nurses picked it up faster than the previous system.
objections.We're focused on care, not technology: Exactly our point — technology should free you to focus on care. Right now, how much time do your clinical staff spend on admin? We typically see 15-20 hours per week freed up per person.
objections.We had a bad CRM implementation before: I hear that a lot. What made it fail? Usually it's because the system required too much data entry. Agentforce is different — it does the data entry for you based on conversations that are happening anyway.
objections.Our current systems work fine: They might be working, but are they giving you time back? When families call, is someone dropping patient care to answer? That's the gap we're filling.
